svg.title: Vector components through a full rotation
svg.desc: Vector A turns through 360 degrees while its x component A cos theta and y component A sin theta grow, shrink and change sign; a graph traces both against the angle. Animated motion has a static alternative for reduced motion and print.

g.text: Components follow the vector around a full turn
Aₓ = A cos θ and Aᵧ = A sin θ; each component changes sign in two quadrants. The magnitude A never
